statement: Between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-31, a Ukrainian drone or missile attack causes a fire or physical damage at one or more oil refineries in Russia.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters or AP reports a Ukrainian drone or missile attack causing fire or damage at a named oil refinery in Russia between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-31 inclusive, confirmed by a Russian official or the Ukrainian military.
failure_condition: No oil refinery in Russia suffers fire or physical damage from a Ukrainian drone or missile attack between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-31.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15, a drone or missile hits at least one tanker vessel in the Black Sea or Sea of Azov, other than vessels already struck on or before 2026-10-15.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters or AP reports a new drone or missile hit on a named tanker in the Black Sea or Sea of Azov, at sea or in port, occurring between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15 inclusive.
failure_condition: No tanker other than those struck on or before 2026-10-15 is hit by a drone or missile in the Black Sea or Sea of Azov between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-10-16 and 2026-12-31, US forces drop a GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast bomb on a target in Iran or Iranian territorial waters.
resolution: TRUE if the Pentagon or CENTCOM confirms, or Reuters and AP both report citing US officials, that a GBU-43/B was used against a target in Iran or its territorial waters between 2026-10-16 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: No GBU-43/B is dropped by US forces on any target in Iran or Iranian territorial waters between 2026-10-16 and 2026-12-31.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield for 2026-12-31 is above 5.00 percent. Reference: 5.05 percent on the packet date 2026-10-15.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DGS10 shows a value strictly above 5.00 for 2026-12-31. Reference: 5.05 percent on 2026-10-15 per the packet market snapshot.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield for 2026-12-31 is 5.00 percent or lower.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The BLS final-demand Producer Price Index 12-month change for October 2026, in its first release published between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-30, is 6.0 percent or higher. Reference: 6.3 percent for September 2026.
resolution: TRUE if the first BLS release of October 2026 PPI data, published between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-30, shows series WPUFD4 up 6.0 percent or more from October 2025. Reference: 6.3 percent for September 2026.
failure_condition: The October 2026 final-demand PPI 12-month change in its first BLS release is below 6.0 percent, or that release is not published between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-30.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class

resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog contains an entry whose vendorProject names Nextcloud or Collabora with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-15 and 2026-11-30 inclusive.

resolution: TRUE if, by 2026-12-15, AP race calls, or certified state results for races AP has not called, give Democrats 218 or more House seats from the 2026-11-03 general election.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates win 217 or fewer House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election.

failure_condition: Nidal Hasan is not executed between 2026-10-16 and 2027-03-31, whether because of a stay, commutation, rescheduling, or any other cause.

statement: Between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15, at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 200 km of the epicenter of the M7.7 Pitaloza Arriba, Panama mainshock, USGS event us6000u18k.
resolution: TRUE if a USGS ComCat search for magnitude 6.0 or greater within 200 km of the us6000u18k epicenter returns at least one event with a UTC origin date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15 inclusive.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 200 km of the us6000u18k epicenter between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15 UTC.
